desc: Ideation and approach selection: use good-gap boundary mask DP rather than per-square simulation.
Implement input parsing, merging of bad intervals into maximal bad blocks, early No for block length >= B, and construction of good gaps with S, E, last_start, last_len, off, first_mask.
Implement propagate(g, entry_mask) to compute the exit mask over the last last_len squares using exact small-distance reachability and the large-distance threshold/congruence rule.
Implement jump_out(g, exit_mask) to update entry masks of all later gaps h with S[h] - E[g] <= B using bit shifts for jumps of length A..B.
Implement the main DP loop over gaps in order, handle zero entry for the final gap, check the bit for N in the final gap's exit mask, and print Yes/No.
Verify correctness on the provided samples (all 3 passed) and review edge cases: short gaps, A=B, skip-gap jumps, and threshold behavior.
